title: AITA for being annoyed that my disabled sister doesn’t do anything? (Read for full story)
question: AITA for being annoyed that my disabled sister doesn’t do anything? (Read for full story)
body:
So my sister has a few physical and mental disabilities. Nothing too serious, like she’s aware of everything, it’s just that she has a 9th grade learning level and and her JRA is pretty bad. But not all the time 


And this is why i’m making this post. She stays at home all the time during the weekends watching netflix. She only comes downstairs if she’s hungry and she doesn’t even wash her dish (We have a strict “wash your own dishes” policy at our house) and if someone asks her to help with anything, she suddenly has a spitting headache that can only be cured by watching more Riverdale. She doesn’t do anything at all. My family is very religious and my mom makes it a point to go to church every sunday. Except her. She only goes to church on Christmas, Easter and when we sponsor food (Church goes from 9:00 am to 2:00 pm, so people sponsor lunch)

I feel like it’s unfair that one day she’s totally fine to hang out with her bf for 13 hours but the next day she can’t come downstairs to help me and my mom cook for 30 minutes.


It’s really annoying at times, especially when I’m really tired, like after a track workout or after the Good Friday service (Total time of 9 hours of strict prayer) and there are dishes in the sink but she can’t because she’s to “tired”


Am I the Asshole for being annoyed at my sister?
